description: Add page numbers to a PDF, plus an optional header and footer line. Format tokens: {n}, {total}, {date}, {filename} (e.g. "Page {n} of {total}", "{n} / {total}", "- {n} -"). Choose the corner/edge, start number, how many leading pages to skip (e.g. a cover), a page range, font, size, colour and margin. Numbers stay upright on rotated pages. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-page-numbers/

date.description: Text for {date}. Default: today in the server locale.

file.description: The PDF: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

footer.description: Optional footer text on numbered pages (tokens allowed).

footerAlign.description: Footer alignment: l, c or r.

format.description: Number format with {n}, {total}, {date}, {filename}. Default "Page {n} of {total}". Empty = no number (header/footer only).

header.description: Optional header text on numbered pages (tokens allowed).

headerAlign.description: Header alignment: l, c or r.

margin.description: Distance from the page edge in points. Default 28.

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

pages.description: Pages to number: 1-based list like "1-3, 5, 8-" ("5-" = to the end, "-3" = first three, "3-1" = reversed). Also "all", "odd", "even", "last". Empty = all pages.

position.description: Where the number goes: t/b = top/bottom, l/c/r = left/centre/right. Default "bc".

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

skip.description: Leave this many first pages without a number (e.g. 1 for a cover). Default 0.

start.description: Number of the first numbered page. Default 1.

name: pdf_page_numbers
title: Add page numbers
